entities.title: csharp-minifier
entities.summary: A single-file C# command-line tool that groups tests by method under test, lists and renames identifiers, sets up repository guidance and pre-commit checks, and records agent token benchmarks.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole tool: the project in src/, the xunit tests in tests/, the build settings both share (Directory.Build.props, version 0.0.0-dev) and the README. It has its own build (dotnet) and its own CI stage (minifier); it is not part of the v* release.
boundaries: The skill it copies into repositories is agents/skills/csharp-minifier/SKILL.md in this repository, embedded into the binary at build time.
The pipeline that tests it is ci.sh in the continuous_integration_and_delivery repository, recorded in .dev/pipeline.json.
Code rules for this folder are in src/macos/csharp-style.md.
